title: The Legacy of Thor/Quotes
summary:
"He, he bossed it out of me."
- Tersly to Dante Vale, about how Montehue was able to find the team

"You're a prince."
- Montehue to Dante Vale

"Well, all I can say is it's a good thing I was here."
- Montehue to Dante Vale, after fighting off the Frost Minions of Ymir

"I really don't know what we would have done without you."
-Dante Vale to Montehue
